micro-label.purpose: Compact tags and tiny identity marks.

motion.name: section-entry
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion-safe fade and rise for homepage sections.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Principal form action with a quiet tactile press state.
components.css: .ds-action { min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--control, #0f766e); color: var(--control-foreground, #ffffff); padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 14px/20px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-action:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #115e59); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background, #fafafa), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent, #0f766e); } .ds-action:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Email Field
components.description: Neutral subscription field with the shared focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #71717a); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--background, #fafafa); color: var(--foreground, #18181b); padding: 6px 12px; font: 400 16px/24px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder, #52525b); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent, #0f766e); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Full-pill filter that keeps a touch-friendly target.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #71717a); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--background, #fafafa); color: var(--muted, #52525b); padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 14px/20px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--accent, #0f766e); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent, #0f766e); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Muted Card
components.description: Flat grouped surface for forms and quiet supporting content.
components.html:
Subscribe

Get an email when a new post is published.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-muted, #f4f4f5); color: var(--foreground, #18181b); padding: 16px; font: 400 14px/20px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-weight: 500; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #52525b); }

components.name: Editorial Row
components.description: Evidence row with compact mono metadata and a restrained hover surface.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--foreground, #18181b); padding: 8px; text-decoration: none; font: 400 14px/20px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-row time { color: var(--muted, #52525b); font: 400 12px/16px "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--surface-muted, #f4f4f5); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent, #0f766e); }

narrative.overview:
Quiet ink is a text-first, evidence-led visual system. Near-white and near-black surfaces create the paper, zinc typography provides the ink, and teal is reserved for links, focus, selection, and action. Content sits in a narrow editorial column with modest headings, compact monospaced metadata, light dividers, and generous vertical rhythm.

Personality comes from a restrained pixel-art identity system: Mark's portrait, animated monogram, and poster-cat scene. These elements provide a distinctive digital signature while remaining subordinate to the work, writing, and evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Narrow editorial reading columns use whitespace and hairlines for structure.
Small monospaced metadata stays compact and secondary.
One pixel-art gesture carries a page's character.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal communicates interaction, never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use weight, spacing, and type family before adding size or color.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Create separation with paper, rules, and rhythm. Reserve the large shadow for temporary overlay navigation, never content cards.

dos: Do reserve teal for links, focus, selection, and action.
Do organize document-like content with whitespace, soft surfaces, and light dividers.
Do keep metadata compact, monospaced, and secondary.
Do preserve 44px interactive targets, visible focus, dark-mode parity, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do let one pixel-art element provide the page's personality.
donts: Don't add decorative gradients, shadows, or accent washes.
Don't turn every content block into a bordered card.
Don't use teal for noninteractive emphasis.
Don't add oversized marketing typography or dense dashboard chrome.
Don't animate essential information or ignore reduced-motion preferences.
